resource_descriptions.Disinfectant Provision: The supplied review describes disinfectant provision to support cleaning and sanitation of pig farms.
resource_descriptions.DA-LGU ASF Checkpoint Monitoring: DA-LGU checkpoint monitoring is an agency activity described in the review to support ASF prevention and farm biosecurity.
resource_descriptions.Farm Management and Feed-Related Advice: Guidance on farm management, feed management and selection, feed storage, and cost-efficient feeding practices.
resource_descriptions.Biosecurity and Farm Sanitation Advice: Advice on the proper use of footbaths and disinfectants, regular cleaning of pig pens and equipment, and limiting unnecessary farm visitors.
resource_descriptions.Proper Disinfection and Sanitation Advic: Advice on using disinfectants properly to clean pig pens and other farm areas and maintaining regular sanitation practices.
resource_descriptions.Biosecurity Advice: Basic guidance on cleaning and disinfection of pig farms to support farm biosecurity.
